tagline: Welcome! I'm just a passionate reader who, along the way, stumbled upon stories that stuck with me — and wanted to share them with other fans. I translate them carefully and give them a reading experience worthy of them: ambient soundtracks, character art, and a visual theme tailored to each universe.
credit_note: One important note: these stories aren't mine. They're the work of authors I admire, whom I contacted for permission before translating and publishing them here. If a story moves you, all the credit belongs to them — I'm just a fan who wanted, in his own small way, to pay tribute to their work and share it with fellow enthusiasts.
media_disclaimer: The same goes for the character images and audio tracks featured on this site: I'm neither their author nor their owner. They come from official wikis and other community sites, and remain the property of their respective rights holders (studios, publishers, artists). They are used here for non-commercial purposes only, to enrich the reading experience for fellow fans.
